tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background on every screen. Warm cream, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, quest rows, sheets, inputs and the bottom navigation, on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, photo placeholders, quiet chips. Sits on `ground` or `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `accent` and `accent-soft`. Also the fill of the prize card and the audit badge, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, meta lines, unselected tabs) on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: nav top border, sheet grip, card drop edge. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control: unchecked quest circle, input outline, plain button outline. 3:1 on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one bright color. Primary button, today score card, leader highlight, winner screen. Text on it is always `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Only the pressed-edge under an `accent` button (`shadow-button`). Never text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tab, leader row, banners and empty-state art. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`. Never white.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive quests: checked circle fill, points text on `gain-soft` and on `surface`.

tokens.name: gain-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a positive points pill and a positive quest icon. Text on it is `gain` or `ink`.

tokens.name: on-gain
tokens.usage: Check mark on a `gain` fill.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative quests: solid fill of a negative points pill, dashed border of a negative quest row, text on `loss-soft`.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a selected negative quest row. Text on it is `loss` or `ink`.

tokens.name: on-loss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `loss` fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind a sheet.

tokens.name: avatar-coral
tokens.usage: Avatar disc. Face marks on it are `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-sky
tokens.usage: Avatar disc. Face marks on it are `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-mint
tokens.usage: Avatar disc. Face marks on it are `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-lilac
tokens.usage: Avatar disc; also a confetti color. Face marks on it are `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-pink
tokens.usage: Avatar disc. Face marks on it are `ink`.

tokens.name: avatar-lime
tokens.usage: Avatar disc. Face marks on it are `ink`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Today score, winner points. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, prize name, day name.

styles.name: points
styles.usage: Numbers inside a points pill and in rank rows.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Quest names, member names, sheet text, input text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons (small), field labels, tabs of a segmented control.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, badges, nav labels. Smallest size in the app.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row (avatar to name).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top padding of a screen, sheet side padding. Also the cover grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a sheet, breathing room around empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photo thumbnails, explanation notes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Quest rows, rank rows, day cards, inputs, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Score card, prize card, top corners of a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, points pills, badges, segmented controls, bars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Flat drop edge under every `surface` card on `ground`. No blur.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Chunky pressed-edge under an `accent` button; remove it and move the button down 4px while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Lift of a bottom sheet over the scrim.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target for anything that can be pressed.

tokens.name: tap-primary
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation, including 20px for the home-indicator safe area.

tokens.name: screen-width
tokens.usage: Design width. Layouts are one column and stretch from 320px to 480px.
